fields.title: Full-Stack Developer
fields.description: Build complete web applications using frontend and backend technologies. Work across the entire stack from UI design to database architecture.

fields.title: Data Scientist
fields.description: Extract insights from complex datasets, build predictive models, and drive data-informed decisions for businesses.

fields.title: Product Manager
fields.description: Lead product development from conception to launch. Work with cross-functional teams to deliver user-centric solutions.

fields.title: Cloud Engineer
fields.description: Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure. Ensure scalability, reliability, and security of cloud-based systems.

fields.title: UI/UX Designer
fields.description: Design intuitive user interfaces and seamless user experiences for digital products. Conduct user research and iterate on designs.

fields.title: DevOps Engineer
fields.description: Bridge development and operations by automating pipelines, managing CI/CD, and ensuring system reliability at scale.

fields.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
fields.description: Plan and execute online marketing campaigns. Manage SEO, SEM, social media, and content marketing to drive growth.
